title: Camera Model
description: ROADMAP Phase 1A step 3: engine-neutral camera behaviour the Unreal sandbox must implement (Rule 22 / Decision 0002). The camera is a PURE CONSUMER of authoritative state - it never writes simulation state and never reads sealed data. Definitions only; no engine implementation is claimed (Rule 18).

writes_simulation_state.description: Rule 13 / criterion E.19: the camera is downstream of truth. A camera that can influence simulation state would make resimulation depend on presentation.

participates_in_determinism_hash.description: Criterion E.20: replay reproduces recorded PRESENTATION from a saved log. Camera output is therefore excluded from the authoritative event-log hash, but must itself be a pure function of that log (see derivation).

derivation.description: Same log + same tick -> same framing. This is what makes replay reproducible without rerunning uncertain decisions.

priority.description: Higher wins. Must form a strict total order (no ties).

both_fighters_framed.description: Criterion F.24: during live exchange the spectator must be able to see cause and effect. Modes active during the round segment must keep both fighters framed.

distance_bands.description: Range bands (movement_model.json) this framing serves. Empty = not range-driven.

max_hold_ticks.description: Tick-anchored duration cap; null = holds until its trigger clears. No wall-clock timers (criterion E.19).

contact_window_cut_prohibited.description: Rule 19: visual speed may not destroy readable cause and effect. No cut may land between a punch's active window and its outcome event.
